basic_info.description: Newly renovated Condo at the doorstep of Golden Gate Park boasts views of the Park and Sutro Tower, along with a unique sense of openness rarely found in the city. The main level features 3 spacious bedrooms and 2.5 baths, while the lower level offers a private bedroom, full bath, and a sleek wet bar leading to a serene garden retreat. Whether you're looking for additional income potential, a comfortable space for multi-generational living, or the perfect au-pair suite, this lower level provides endless possibilities. Located just steps from the vibrant restaurants and shops of Irving Street, with easy access to 19th Ave for commuting to South Bay on I-280 and close proximity to Ocean Beach, this home offers both urban convenience and natural beauty in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a piece of the city's best!
